revenue_scope: Worldwide Other Oncology line of the Innovative Medicine segment, including Zytiga (US + Intl = WW rows of the key-products exhibit)
why_separate: Zytiga is no longer a line of its own from 2026Q1; its sales are inside Other Oncology together with products the issuer does not itemise, so the figure is a broader line, not Zytiga's own sales.
notes: Measured: the 1Q26 and 2Q26 Other Financial Disclosures PDFs have no ZYTIGA row; the OTHER ONCOLOGY row carries footnote (3) 'Includes the sales of ZYTIGA which were previously disclosed separately'. The same footnote appears in the Forms 10-Q for 2026Q1 (0000200406-26-000087) and 2026Q2 (0000200406-26-000153). The 4Q25 exhibit still printed ZYTIGA (WW 119 for Q4) and a separate OTHER ONCOLOGY row (WW 100), so the 2026 line is not comparable with the 2025 Other Oncology row. J&J names no other product inside the line.
